'''Dathomir Amber''' was a rare substance that could be found along the lakes and creeks of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was highly priced for its use in jewelry and decorations.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] received several pieces of Dathomir Amber as a reward from the local witches.
